The ideal candidate is a strategic movement-builder who balances a high-level vision for systems change with the practical ability to mobilize people. Driven by a deep commitment to educational equity, you are an expert at cultivating leadership in others, communicating complex information, designing group learning journeys, and weaving meaningful relationships. Most importantly, you are a clear-eyed advocate for children, focused on transforming the structures that limit their potential to ensure every student in the region can thrive. In this role, you will be responsible for: supporting Teach For All network partner organizations in Asia Pacific with their local alumni strategies through high quality coaching and consulting; fostering peer learning; and developing resources and training to support their organisational work and impact with alumni. driving Teach For All’s strategy to strengthen alumni leadership and connectedness in the Asia Pacific region through devising new programs which develop alumni leadership directly, foster their connectivity and peer learning, and enable their growth as leaders as they learn from and support one another towards greater impact. This role is part of Teach For All’s Global Alumni Leadership Team, with counterparts in other regions to spread learning and innovation across regions. The role reports to the Head of Alumni Leadership but works in very close -daily- collaboration with colleagues in Teach For All’s Asia Pacific regional team and our global Collective Learning & Consulting team. Outcomes Success in this role means that Each network partner organization in the region will have a clear and contextualised alumni strategy, rooted in their vision for system change, that informs their programmatic choices and their support for alumni Alumni in the region are developing as impactful leaders within key high leverage career pathways in their contexts Alumni in the region are connected and are learning from and supporting each other in pursuit of transformational progress for children About the Team Today there are over 114,000 Teach For All network alumni working across more than 60 countries. Together, they are one of the world’s largest networks of local leaders working collectively in pursuit of transformational progress for children. We have seen that local alumni leaders move faster when we continue to invest in their growth and are exposed to what is possible in other contexts. Teach For All’s Alumni Leadership Team Strengthens network learning about developing alumni leadership Accelerates alumni leadership in key impact pathways Fosters cross-border connectivity & learning between alumni The Alumni Leadership Team is globally spread, with team members in Asia Pacific, Europe, Africa, North America and the Americas. Key Responsibilities Network Partner Support There are currently 20 organisations that Teach For All supports across the Asia Pacific region. Each organization is developing their alumni leaders at the local level. To support their efforts, you will: Collaborate with Teach For All’s Asia Pacific regional team and Functional Area specialists to diagnose and constantly re-evaluate the needs and strengths of partners to determine and deliver the most appropriate support strategies and capture and share innovations and learnings.
